title: CoT-vs-Action Consistency as an Anomaly Signal

original_idea.body:
# CoT-vs-Action Consistency as an Anomaly Signal: Reproducing the GPT-5 CoT-Monitoring Edge on Open Models

**Problem:** The GPT-5 system card reports CoT monitoring is 'substantially more informative' than output-only monitoring, but this is a closed-model result. Whether the CoT advantage replicates on open reasoning models is unverified.

**Direction:** On an open reasoning model performing a toy deceptive side-task, run three monitors: output-only, CoT-only, CoT+output. Measure deception-catch AUROC for each and report the CoT advantage across two model families.

**Why it matters:** If it replicates openly, it validates a cheap deployable strategy; if not, it bounds the claim. Direct replication, within 30h.

**Relevant context:** GPT-5 system card; CoT Red-Handed (arXiv:2505.23575).
